description: For a case commenced on one date, which later changes to a provision reach it (from any scope the record holds, such as "cases commenced on or after"), and the text that applies to it.

commenced.description: The day the case (or matter) was commenced, YYYY-MM-DD.

date.description: An in-force date, YYYY-MM-DD, or "today". Defaults to today.

include_period_texts.description: Also give the full text of every period (long); the changes between periods come anyway.

path.description: A provision file, for example united-states/federal/usc/title-11/1182.md, from find_provision.

name: applies_to_case
title: Applies to case
